source_text: Aperit Noe fenestram. Corvus exit nec revertitur; columba revertitur cum ramo olivae. Corvus — immundus sensus circa morticina saeculi; columba — Spiritus et anima simplex ad arcam ecclesiae cum signo pacis.
pass_a_gloss: Opens Noah window. Raven goes-out and-not returns; dove returns with branch of-olive. Raven — unclean sense around corpses of-age; dove — Spirit and soul simple toward ark of-church with sign of-peace.
pass_b_english: Noah opens the [[window >> Bible:Genesis 8:6]]. The [[raven goes out and does not return >> Bible:Genesis 8:7]]; the [[dove returns with an olive branch >> Bible:Genesis 8:11]]. The raven is an unclean sense lingering by the world’s corpses; the dove is the Spirit and the simple soul coming back to the church’s ark with the sign of peace.
